cd /workspace/project && timeout 900 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,subprocess,time
OB=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()
def bal():
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/get_user_balance",headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=30) as x: return json.load(x)['balance']
def send(model,prompt="hi",mt=100):
    b=json.dumps({"model":model,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":prompt}],"max_tokens":mt}).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=b,
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=180) as x: return json.load(x)
tests=["openai/gpt-6-astra","anthropic/claude-opus-5.5","x-ai/grok-4.7",
       "google/gemini-4-argon","deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored",
       "qwen/qwen3.8-27b-uncensored","z-ai/glm-5.3-uncensored","meta-llama/llama-4-scout"]
print(f"{'MODEL':44} {'cost dilaporkan':>16} {'delta saldo':>12}")
for m in tests:
    try:
        b0=bal(); d=send(m); time.sleep(1.2); b1=bal()
        c=d['usage']['cost']
        print(f"{m:44} ${c:>14.6f} ${b0-b1:>10.4f}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: print(f"{m:44} HTTP{e.code} {e.read().decode()[:60]}")
    except Exception as e: print(f"{m:44} ERR {str(e)[:50]}")
